sections.title: Choosing between two rooms
sections.content: The comparative -bb you already know for weather (melegebb, hidegebb) works just as well for choosing a hotel room: nagyobb ("bigger"), kisebb ("smaller"), csendesebb ("quieter"). Watch for the irregular szép → szebb ("nicer", not szépebb). Use mint right before what you're comparing to, exactly as before.

items.spanish: Ez a szoba nagyobb, mint az.
items.english: This room is bigger than that one.

items.spanish: A kétágyas szoba csendesebb, mint az egyágyas.
items.english: The double room is quieter than the single.

sections.content: szép is one of the few adjectives that shortens instead of just adding -bb: szép → szebb, not szépebb. It's common enough — describing rooms, views, cities — that it's worth memorizing on its own.
